name: ContactCenterAsteriskGaCore
description: Enables the supported GA-Core Contact Center feature set for the Asterisk voice provider in one step: base orchestration and administration, the agents (profiles and availability), work distribution (queues and routing), the agent desktop with its soft-phone call control, real-time updates, preview/manual dialing, and the Asterisk Contact Center voice adapter. This is the coherent, certified feature combination for the 'ga-core-asterisk' tenant profile; configure an Asterisk provider and your queues, skills, and entry points afterward to route calls.
author: CrestApps
